static_traits.name: 林嘉怡
static_traits.family_status: Lives with family in Florida, USA; family is fairly supportive, but she finds it hard to confide academic distress to her family
static_traits.social_status: 因自觉能力not足而与朋友和同学疏离
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病；既往without类似心理问题与治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 初始略显紧张但愿意表达，叙述清晰、逻辑性Good，有自我Reflection能力；存在自我标签化与负性自动思维；配合度高、态度积极

basic_info.main_problem: 我在科学课上的表现让我感到without能和自我价值低，这种感觉从本学期开始，几乎每天都会出现，尤其是在收到科学作业反馈之后。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些without能感正在影响我的自尊和学习动力。
growth_experiences: 本学期开始时对科学学业有较高自我期待；随着作业和测试成绩低于期望，这些结果逐步Reinforcement了“我not聪明”的信念，负性体验几乎每日出现，伴随Anxiety、Sleep and diet rhythms disrupted。
The family as a whole is fairly supportive，但她难以向家人表达学业上的困扰，这在一定程度上限制了外部情感支持的获取。

special_situations.event: Receiving low-score feedback on science homework or quizzes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我成绩not好，就说明我not聪明
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Studies harder and seeks extra help from teachers, trying to prove self through effort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我很蠢/I am not smart enough

special_situations.event: When starting or doing science-related tasks (such as exam preparation, homework)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果这次又失败，就证明我永远学not好科学
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与朋友互动，独自苦读，同时持续担忧
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我肯定会搞砸/I will fail

special_situations.event: 回顾曾在部分小测验或理解某些概念时的Good表现
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 零星的好表现not算数，整体not好就等于not聪明
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽略正向证据，只关注负面成绩与反馈
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些做得还行也have not意义，我还是not行

special_situations.event: 面对自己为科学设定的高标准却not yet达成
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I should get the ideal high score, otherwise it is failure and stupidity
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubly hard work, extending study time, to meet the 'should' standard
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该做得更好，否则我就是笨

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被看见为有能力、被认可与接纳
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评价为愚蠢、被negate与羞辱
defense_goal: 通过自我隔离减少外界评价带来的威胁
通过过度用功来维持对自我价值的掌控感

object_relations.self_representation: not够聪明、容易失败的学习者
object_relations.object_representation: Others with judgment and standards (teachers, classmates, family)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing science grades or asked to examine evidence of 'smart/capable'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他人会认为I am not smart enough，我会被negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气自责、降低音量，反复use自我贬低用语（如“I am not smart enough”），淡化他人正面反馈，较少表达对外部评价的not满。

manifestations: 因自觉能力not足而主动与朋友和同学疏离
Finds it hard to open up to supportive family about academic distress, reducing access to external support
outcomes: Damaged self-esteem and reduced sense of self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在叙述中频繁Self-denial（如“I am not smart enough”）
初始紧张、小心表达，担心“说错/做not好”
正向证据被弱化，持续自我苛责

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 面对Academic pressure时选择独自承受并与同伴疏离
Knowing there is family support but finding it hard to ask for help, turns pressure inward into self-blame and self-pressure

exception_events.target_problem: 在科学学科学习与测验情境下，来访者通常会陷入“I am not smart enough”的想法并感到Anxiety，注意力受影响、Decreased drive。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在部分小测验以及理解某些科学概念的时刻，来访者并not yet像以往那样完全被负面想法困住，而是表现“还可以/理解到位”，获得了一定的掌握感。
exception_events.reason: Cues: had put in extra study effort and sought help from the teacher; when tasks are more focused or concepts are explained clearly, it is easier to gain a sense of mastery and positive feedback.

positive_force: The family as a whole is fairly supportive
Study motivation is still present, willing to work harder and proactively seek help
能够识do not并尝试重构负性想法（愿意进行行为实验）
Has successful experience in some quizzes and concept understanding, has ability evidence
negative_force: 自我标签化与全或without的能力评价标准
倾向忽略正向证据、只关注负面反馈
对not yet来失败的灾难化/预测性担忧
Social avoidance导致支持减少，进一步放大without助感
Sleep and diet disturbed, lowering study efficiency and emotional tolerance

target_behavior.behavior: 与学业相关的Anxiety与自我贬低（如“I am not smart enough/我很蠢”）
antecedent: Receiving low-score feedback on science homework or quizzes
开始准备科学作业、测验或考试时
target_behavior.core_reason: The labeling belief that equates academic grades with intelligence and self-worth, and the black-and-white standard for evaluating ability
target_behavior.function: Escapes the threat of being evaluated, gains temporary control over self-worth
target_behavior.consequence: Learning motivation and focus decline, negative emotions intensify, forming a vicious cycle of 'low performance - negative beliefs'

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance（与朋友和同学疏离）
antecedent: 在校园中谈及或想到科学成绩not理想
Anticipation同伴或他人会评价自己的学业能力
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被视为“not聪明”，以Avoids socializing评价来降低羞耻与Anxiety
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的社交评价与可能的失败暴露
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support、Loneliness感增加，进一步加重without助与低自尊

antecedent: 在学习或复盘科学任务时的持续紧张与反刍
对即将到来的作业/测验的担忧
target_behavior.core_reason: 对失败与能力not足的灾难化预测与持续担忧，难以情绪放松
target_behavior.function: Physically reflects stress and vigilance, trying to prepare for 'avoiding failure'
target_behavior.consequence: 精力与认知Decreased efficiency，进一步影响学习表现并Reinforcement负性信念
